
=== WebPanel: Produccion.listarProductos ===

--- Start (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Grid.Rows = Page.Rows
	Grid_Empowerer.GridInternalName = Grid.InternalName
	DDO_GridColumnsSelector.GridInternalName = Grid.InternalName
	If &HTTPRequest.Method = HttpMethod.Get
		Do 'LoadSavedFilters'
	EndIf
	ddo_AGExport.TitleControlIdToReplace = BtnAGExport.InternalName
	&AGExportData = new()
	
	&AGExportDataItem = new()
	&AGExportDataItem.Title = ''
	&AGExportDataItem.Icon = ActionExport.Link()
	&AGExportDataItem.EventKey = !'Export'
	&AGExportDataItem.IsDivider = False
	&AGExportData.Add(&AGExportDataItem)
	
	&AGExportDataItem = new()
	&AGExportDataItem.Title = ''
	&AGExportDataItem.Icon = ActionExportReport.Link()
	&AGExportDataItem.EventKey = !'ExportReport'
	&AGExportDataItem.IsDivider = False
	&AGExportData.Add(&AGExportDataItem)
	
	&GAMSession = GAMSession.Get(&GAMErrors)
	DDO_Grid.GridInternalName = Grid.InternalName
	DDO_Grid.GAMOAuthToken = &GAMSession.Token
	Form.Caption = ' Producto'
	Do 'PrepareTransaction'
	Do 'LoadGridState'
	If &OrderedBy < 1
		&OrderedBy = 1
		Do 'SetDDOSortedStatus'
	EndIf
	&DDO_TitleSettingsIcons = GetWWPTitleSettingsIcons()
	DDO_GridColumnsSelector.TitleControlIdToReplace = BtnEditColumns.InternalName
	GridPaginationBar.RowsPerPageSelectedValue = Grid.Rows
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Refresh (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)
	Do 'CheckSecurityForActions'
	Do Case
		Case &ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 1
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
		Case &ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 0
			Do 'LoadSavedFilters'
	EndCase
	Do 'SaveGridState'
	
	If &Session.Get(!'Produccion.listarProductosColumnsSelector') <> ''
		&ColumnsSelectorXML = &Session.Get(!'Produccion.listarProductosColumnsSelector')
		&ColumnsSelector.FromXml(&ColumnsSelectorXML)
	Else
		Do 'InitializeColumnsSelector'
	EndIf
	ProductoCategoriaNombre.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(1).IsVisible
	ProductoBaseProductoClave.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(2).IsVisible
	ProductoClave.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(3).IsVisible
	ProductoNombre.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(4).IsVisible
	ProductoDescripcion.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(5).IsVisible
	ProductoPrecioUnitario.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(6).IsVisible
	ProductoInventarioActual.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(7).IsVisible
	ProductoTipoMaterial.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(8).IsVisible
	ProductoActivo.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(9).IsVisible
	ProductoClaveExterna.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(10).IsVisible
	ProductoImagen.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(11).IsVisible
	ProductNumber.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(12).IsVisible
	&GridCurrentPage = Grid.CurrentPage
	&GridPageCount = Grid.PageCount
	&GridAppliedFilters = WWP_GetAppliedFiltersDescription(&Pgmname)
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- GridPaginationBar.ChangePage (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage = !'Previous'
			Grid.PreviousPage()
		Case GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage = !'Next'
			Grid.NextPage()
		Otherwise
			&PageToGo.FromString(GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage)
			Grid.GotoPage(&PageToGo)
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- GridPaginationBar.ChangeRowsPerPage (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Grid.Rows = GridPaginationBar.RowsPerPageSelectedValue
	Grid.FirstPage()
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- DDO_Grid.OnOptionClicked (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderASC#>' OR DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderDSC#>'
			&OrderedBy.FromString(DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get)
			&OrderedDsc = iif(DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderDSC#>', true, false)
			Do 'SetDDOSortedStatus'
			Grid.FirstPage()
		Case DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Filter#>'
			Do Case
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ProductoCategoriaNombre'
					&TFProductoCategoriaNombre = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFProductoCategoriaNombre_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ProductoBaseProductoClave'
					&TFProductoBaseProductoClave = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFProductoBaseProductoClave_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ProductoClave'
					&TFProductoClave = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFProductoClave_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ProductoNombre'
					&TFProductoNombre = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFProductoNombre_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ProductoDescripcion'
					&TFProductoDescripcion = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFProductoDescripcion_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ProductoPrecioUnitario'
					&TFProductoPrecioUnitario.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFProductoPrecioUnitario_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ProductoInventarioActual'
					&TFProductoInventarioActual.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFProductoInventarioActual_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ProductoTipoMaterial'
					&TFProductoTipoMaterial_SelsJson = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
					&TFProductoTipoMaterial_Sels.FromJson(&TFProductoTipoMaterial_SelsJson)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ProductoActivo'
					&TFProductoActivo_Sel.FromString(DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ProductoClaveExterna'
					&TFProductoClaveExterna.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFProductoClaveExterna_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ProductNumber'
					&TFProductNumber = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFProductNumber_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
			EndCase
			Grid.FirstPage()
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Grid.Load (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	&Display = "GXM_display"
	If (&IsAuthorized_Display)
		&Display.Link = gestionarProducto.Link(TrnMode.Display, ProductoId)
	Endif
	&Update = "GXM_update"
	If (&IsAuthorized_Update)
		&Update.Link = gestionarProducto.Link(TrnMode.Update, ProductoId)
	Endif
	&Delete = "GX_BtnDelete"
	If (&IsAuthorized_Delete)
		&Delete.Link = gestionarProducto.Link(TrnMode.Delete, ProductoId)
	Endif
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- DDO_GridColumnsSelector.OnColumnsChanged (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	&ColumnsSelectorXML = DDO_GridColumnsSelector.ColumnsSelectorValues
	&ColumnsSelector.FromJson(&ColumnsSelectorXML)
	SaveColumnsSelectorState(!'Produccion.listarProductosColumnsSelector', iif(&ColumnsSelectorXML.IsEmpty(), '', &ColumnsSelector.ToXml()))
	Refresh
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- ddo_ManageFilters.OnOptionClicked (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Clean#>'
			Do 'CleanFilters'
			Grid.FirstPage()
			Refresh
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Save#>'
			Do 'SaveGridState'
			SaveFilterAs.Popup(!'Produccion.listarProductosFilters', &PgmName + !"GridState")
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			Refresh
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Manage#>'
			ManageFilters.Popup(!'Produccion.listarProductosFilters')
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			Refresh
		Otherwise
			&ManageFiltersXml = GetFilterByName(!'Produccion.listarProductosFilters', ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey)
			If &ManageFiltersXml.IsEmpty()
				msg('WWP_FilterNotExist')
			Else
				Do 'CleanFilters'
				SaveGridState.Call(&PgmName + !"GridState",  &ManageFiltersXml)
				&GridState.FromXml(&ManageFiltersXml)
				&OrderedBy = &GridState.OrderedBy
				&OrderedDsc = &GridState.OrderedDsc
				Do 'SetDDOSortedStatus' 
				Do 'LoadRegFiltersState'
				Grid.FirstPage()
				Refresh
			EndIf
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- ddo_AGExport.OnOptionClicked (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case ddo_AGExport.ActiveEventKey = !'Export'
			Do 'DoExport'
		Case ddo_AGExport.ActiveEventKey = !'ExportReport'
			Do 'DoExportReport'
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- 'DocmdAgregar' (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	If (&IsAuthorized_cmdAgregar)
		gestionarProducto.Call(TrnMode.Insert, &ProductoId)
	Else
		msg("WWP_ActionNoLongerAvailable")
		Refresh
	Endif
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Rules (Rules) ---

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */



	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


=== Transaction: DB.Producto ===

--- Start (Event) ---
/* Generated by Work With Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	[web]
	{
	If not IsAuthorized(&PgmName)
		NotAuthorized(&PgmName)
	Endif
	
	&TrnContext.FromXml(&WebSession.Get(!"TrnContext"))
	&Insert_ProductoCategoriaId.SetEmpty()
	&Insert_ProductoBaseProductoId.SetEmpty()
	&Insert_ProductNumber.SetEmpty()
	
	If (&TrnContext.TransactionName = &Pgmname and &Mode = TrnMode.Insert)
		For &TrnContextAtt in &TrnContext.Attributes
			Do Case
				// When inserting with instantiated ProductoCategoriaId
				Case &TrnContextAtt.AttributeName = !"ProductoCategoriaId"
					&Insert_ProductoCategoriaId.FromString(&TrnContextAtt.AttributeValue)
				// When inserting with instantiated ProductoBaseProductoId
				Case &TrnContextAtt.AttributeName = !"ProductoBaseProductoId"
					&Insert_ProductoBaseProductoId.FromString(&TrnContextAtt.AttributeValue)
				// When inserting with instantiated ProductNumber
				Case &TrnContextAtt.AttributeName = !"ProductNumber"
					&Insert_ProductNumber.FromString(&TrnContextAtt.AttributeValue)
			Endcase
		Endfor
	Endif
	
	If &Mode = TrnMode.Delete
		btn_Enter.Caption = "GX_BtnDelete"
		btn_Enter.TooltipText = "GX_BtnDelete"
	EndIf
	}
	/* Generated by Work With Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- After Trn (Event) ---
/* Generated by Work With Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	[web]
	{
	If (&Mode = TrnMode.Delete and not &TrnContext.CallerOnDelete)
		WWProducto()
	Endif
	
	Return
	}
	/* Generated by Work With Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Rules (Rules) ---
/* Generated by Work With Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
[web]
{
parm(in:&Mode, in:&ProductoId);

ProductoId = &ProductoId if not &ProductoId.IsEmpty();
noaccept(ProductoId);
noprompt(ProductoId);

ProductoCategoriaId = &Insert_ProductoCategoriaId if &Mode = TrnMode.Insert and not &Insert_ProductoCategoriaId.IsEmpty();
noaccept(ProductoCategoriaId) if &Mode = TrnMode.Insert and not &Insert_ProductoCategoriaId.IsEmpty();
ProductoBaseProductoId = &Insert_ProductoBaseProductoId if &Mode = TrnMode.Insert and not &Insert_ProductoBaseProductoId.IsEmpty();
noaccept(ProductoBaseProductoId) if &Mode = TrnMode.Insert and not &Insert_ProductoBaseProductoId.IsEmpty();
ProductNumber = &Insert_ProductNumber if &Mode = TrnMode.Insert and not &Insert_ProductNumber.IsEmpty();
noaccept(ProductNumber) if &Mode = TrnMode.Insert and not &Insert_ProductNumber.IsEmpty();}
/* Generated by Work With Pattern [End] - Do not change */


=== WebPanel: Produccion.gestionarProducto ===

--- Start (Event) ---
&AuditTableName = !'Producto'
	Do Case
		Case &TrnMode = TrnMode.Insert
			&Producto.ProductoActivo = True
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	&LoadSuccess = True
	If (&TrnMode = TrnMode.Display)
		OR (&TrnMode = TrnMode.Insert AND SecGAMIsAuthByFunctionalityKey.Udp(!'producto_Insert'))
		OR (&TrnMode = TrnMode.Update AND SecGAMIsAuthByFunctionalityKey.Udp(!'producto_Update'))
		OR (&TrnMode = TrnMode.Delete AND SecGAMIsAuthByFunctionalityKey.Udp(!'producto_Delete'))
		If &TrnMode <> TrnMode.Insert
			&Producto.Load(&ProductoId)
			&LoadSuccess = &Producto.Success()
			If not &LoadSuccess
				&Messages = &Producto.GetMessages()
				Do 'Show Messages'
			EndIf
			If &TrnMode = TrnMode.Display OR &TrnMode = TrnMode.Delete
				Producto_ProductNumber.Enabled = False
				Producto_ProductoCategoriaId.Enabled = False
				Producto_ProductoClave.Enabled = False
				Producto_ProductoNombre.Enabled = False
				Producto_ProductoDescripcion.Enabled = False
				Producto_ProductoPrecioUnitario.Enabled = False
				Producto_ProductoInventarioActual.Enabled = False
				Producto_ProductoClaveExterna.Enabled = False
				Producto_ProductoTipoMaterial.Enabled = False
				Producto_ProductoImagen.Enabled = False
				Producto_ProductoActivo.Enabled = False
				&ProductoCategoriaId.Enabled = False
				Combo_ProductoBaseProductoId.Enabled = False
			EndIf
		EndIf
	Else
		&LoadSuccess = False
	EndIf
	If &LoadSuccess
		If &TrnMode = TrnMode.Delete
			msg('GXM_confdelete')
		EndIf
	EndIf
	&DDO_TitleSettingsIcons = GetWWPTitleSettingsIcons()
	&ProductoBaseProductoId.Visible = False
	Do 'LoadComboProductoBaseProductoId'
	Do 'AttributesSecurityCode'
	Producto_ProductoId.Visible = False
	wcAuditoria.Object = AuditHistoryById.Create(&AuditTableName, &ProductoId)
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Refresh (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do 'CheckSecurityForActions'
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Combo_ProductoBaseProductoId.OnOptionClicked (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	&ProductoBaseProductoId.FromString(Combo_ProductoBaseProductoId.SelectedValue_get)
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */
	If  &ProductoBaseProductoId > 0
		&SDTProducto = ProductoDP.Udp(&ProductoBaseProductoId)
		If &SDTProducto.Count > 0
			&Producto.ProductoTipoMaterial = &SDTProducto.Item(1).ProductoTipoMaterial
			Do Case
				Case &TrnMode = TrnMode.Insert
					&Producto.ProductoClave = &SDTProducto.Item(1).ProductoClave
			EndCase
			
		EndIf
	Else
		Do Case
			Case &TrnMode = TrnMode.Insert
				&Producto.ProductoClave = ''
		EndCase
	EndIf
	Do 'CheckSecurityForActions'

--- Enter (Event) ---
If Not &ProductoBaseProductoId > 0
			&Producto.ProductoBaseProductoId.SetNull()
		Else
			&Producto.ProductoBaseProductoId = &ProductoBaseProductoId
		EndIf
	if(&Producto.ProductNumber.IsEmpty())
		&Producto.ProductNumber.SetNull()
	endif
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	If &TrnMode <> TrnMode.Display
		If &TrnMode <> TrnMode.Delete
			Do 'CheckRequiredFields'
		EndIf
		If &TrnMode = TrnMode.Delete OR &CheckRequiredFieldsResult
			If &TrnMode = TrnMode.Delete
				&Producto.Delete()
			Else
				&Producto.Save()
			EndIf
			If &Producto.Success()
				Do 'After_Trn'
			Else
				&Messages = &Producto.GetMessages()
				Do 'Show Messages'
			EndIf
		EndIf
	EndIf
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- &ProductoCategoriaId.ControlValueChanged (Event) ---
Do 'LoadComboProductoBaseProductoId'

--- Rules (Rules) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
parm(in:&TrnMode, in:&ProductoId);
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


=== Procedure: Produccion.listarProductosExport ===

--- Source (Source) ---

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

// Exports the contents of a grid (using the selected order and filters) to an Excel file.
LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)

Do 'OpenDocument'

&CellRow = 1
&FirstColumn = 1

Do 'LoadGridState'

Do 'WriteFilters'

Do 'WriteColumnTitles'

Do 'WriteData'

Do 'CloseDocument'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


Sub 'OpenDocument'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&Random = Random() * 10000
	&Filename = !"listarProductosExport-" + &Random.ToString().Trim() + !".xlsx"

	&ExcelDocument.Open(&Filename)
	Do 'CheckStatus'
	&ExcelDocument.Clear()

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'WriteFilters'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	If not (&FilterFullText.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "WWP_FullTextFilterDescription")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&FilterFullText)
	EndIf
	If not (&TFProductoCategoriaNombre_Sel.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Categoría")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFProductoCategoriaNombre_Sel)
	Else
		If not (&TFProductoCategoriaNombre.IsEmpty())
			WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Categoría")
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFProductoCategoriaNombre)
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not (&TFProductoBaseProductoClave_Sel.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Producto Base")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFProductoBaseProductoClave_Sel)
	Else
		If not (&TFProductoBaseProductoClave.IsEmpty())
			WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Producto Base")
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFProductoBaseProductoClave)
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not (&TFProductoClave_Sel.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Clave")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFProductoClave_Sel)
	Else
		If not (&TFProductoClave.IsEmpty())
			WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Clave")
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFProductoClave)
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not (&TFProductoNombre_Sel.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Nombre")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFProductoNombre_Sel)
	Else
		If not (&TFProductoNombre.IsEmpty())
			WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Nombre")
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFProductoNombre)
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not (&TFProductoDescripcion_Sel.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Descripcion")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFProductoDescripcion_Sel)
	Else
		If not (&TFProductoDescripcion.IsEmpty())
			WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Descripcion")
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFProductoDescripcion)
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not (&TFProductoPrecioUnitario.IsEmpty() AND &TFProductoPrecioUnitario_To.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Precio Unitario")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Number = &TFProductoPrecioUnitario
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, false, &CellRow, &FirstColumn + 2, "WWP_TSTo")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 3).Number = &TFProductoPrecioUnitario_To
	EndIf
	If not (&TFProductoInventarioActual.IsEmpty() AND &TFProductoInventarioActual_To.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Inventario Actual")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Number = &TFProductoInventarioActual
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, false, &CellRow, &FirstColumn + 2, "WWP_TSTo")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 3).Number = &TFProductoInventarioActual_To
	EndIf
	If not (&TFProductoTipoMaterial_Sels.Count = 0)
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Tipo Material")
		&i = 1
		For &TFProductoTipoMaterial_Sel in &TFProductoTipoMaterial_Sels
			If &i = 1
				&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = ''
			Else
				&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text += ', '
			EndIf
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text += &TFProductoTipoMaterial_Sel.EnumerationDescription()
			&i += 1
		EndFor
	EndIf
	If not (&TFProductoActivo_Sel.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Activo")
		Do Case
			Case &TFProductoActivo_Sel = 1
				&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = "WWP_TSChecked"
			Case &TFProductoActivo_Sel = 2
				&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = "WWP_TSUnChecked"
		EndCase
	EndIf
	If not (&TFProductoClaveExterna.IsEmpty() AND &TFProductoClaveExterna_To.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Clave Externa")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Number = &TFProductoClaveExterna
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, false, &CellRow, &FirstColumn + 2, "WWP_TSTo")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 3).Number = &TFProductoClaveExterna_To
	EndIf
	If not (&TFProductNumber_Sel.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Producto SAE")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFProductNumber_Sel)
	Else
		If not (&TFProductNumber.IsEmpty())
			WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Producto SAE")
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFProductNumber)
		EndIf
	EndIf
	&CellRow += 2

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'WriteColumnTitles'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&VisibleColumnCount = 0
	If &Session.Get(!'Produccion.listarProductosColumnsSelector') <> ''
		&ColumnsSelectorXML = &Session.Get(!'Produccion.listarProductosColumnsSelector')
		&ColumnsSelector.FromXml(&ColumnsSelectorXML)
	Else
		Do 'InitializeColumnsSelector'
	EndIf

	&ColumnsSelector.Columns.Sort(!'Order')
	For &ColumnsSelector_Column in &ColumnsSelector.Columns
		If &ColumnsSelector_Column.IsVisible = True
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = GetMessageText(iif(&ColumnsSelector_Column.DisplayName.IsEmpty(), &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName, &ColumnsSelector_Column.DisplayName))
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Bold = True
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Color = 11
			&VisibleColumnCount += 1
		EndIf
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'WriteData'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	For each DB.Producto
		order ProductoNombre  when &OrderedBy = 1 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ProductoNombre)  when &OrderedBy = 1 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ProductoCategoriaNombre  when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ProductoCategoriaNombre)  when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ProductoBaseProductoClave  when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ProductoBaseProductoClave)  when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ProductoClave  when &OrderedBy = 4 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ProductoClave)  when &OrderedBy = 4 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ProductoDescripcion  when &OrderedBy = 5 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ProductoDescripcion)  when &OrderedBy = 5 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ProductoPrecioUnitario  when &OrderedBy = 6 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ProductoPrecioUnitario)  when &OrderedBy = 6 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ProductoInventarioActual  when &OrderedBy = 7 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ProductoInventarioActual)  when &OrderedBy = 7 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ProductoTipoMaterial  when &OrderedBy = 8 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ProductoTipoMaterial)  when &OrderedBy = 8 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ProductoActivo  when &OrderedBy = 9 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ProductoActivo)  when &OrderedBy = 9 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ProductoClaveExterna  when &OrderedBy = 10 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ProductoClaveExterna)  when &OrderedBy = 10 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ProductNumber  when &OrderedBy = 11 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ProductNumber)  when &OrderedBy = 11 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		
		using listarProductosDS(&FilterFullText, &TFProductoCategoriaNombre, &TFProductoCategoriaNombre_Sel, &TFProductoBaseProductoClave, &TFProductoBaseProductoClave_Sel, &TFProductoClave
					, &TFProductoClave_Sel, &TFProductoNombre, &TFProductoNombre_Sel, &TFProductoDescripcion, &TFProductoDescripcion_Sel, &TFProductoPrecioUnitario
					, &TFProductoPrecioUnitario_To, &TFProductoInventarioActual, &TFProductoInventarioActual_To, &TFProductoTipoMaterial_Sels, &TFProductoActivo_Sel, &TFProductoClaveExterna
					, &TFProductoClaveExterna_To, &TFProductNumber, &TFProductNumber_Sel)

		// Write cell values
		&CellRow += 1
		
		Do 'BeforeWriteLine'
		&VisibleColumnCount = 0
		For &ColumnsSelector_Column in &ColumnsSelector.Columns
			If &ColumnsSelector_Column.IsVisible = True
				Do Case
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'ProductoCategoriaNombre'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(ProductoCategoriaNombre)
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'ProductoBaseProductoClave'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(ProductoBaseProductoClave)
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'ProductoClave'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(ProductoClave)
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'ProductoNombre'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(ProductoNombre)
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'ProductoDescripcion'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(ProductoDescripcion)
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'ProductoPrecioUnitario'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Number = ProductoPrecioUnitario
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'ProductoInventarioActual'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Number = ProductoInventarioActual
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'ProductoTipoMaterial'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = ProductoTipoMaterial.EnumerationDescription()
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'ProductoActivo'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = ProductoActivo.ToString()
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'ProductoClaveExterna'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Number = ProductoClaveExterna
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'ProductoImagen'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = ''
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'ProductNumber'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(ProductNumber)
				EndCase
				&VisibleColumnCount += 1
			EndIf
		EndFor		
		
		Do 'AfterWriteLine'

	Endfor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'CloseDocument'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&ExcelDocument.Save()
	Do 'CheckStatus'
	&ExcelDocument.Close()

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'CheckStatus'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	If (&ExcelDocument.ErrCode <> 0)
		&Filename = ""
		&ErrorMessage = &ExcelDocument.ErrDescription
		&ExcelDocument.Close()
		Return
	EndIf

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'InitializeColumnsSelector'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&ColumnsSelector = new WWPColumnsSelector()
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"ProductoCategoriaNombre", '', !'Categoría', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"ProductoBaseProductoClave", '', !'Producto Base', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"ProductoClave", '', !'Clave', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"ProductoNombre", '', !'Nombre', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"ProductoDescripcion", '', !'Descripcion', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"ProductoPrecioUnitario", '', !'Precio Unitario', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"ProductoInventarioActual", '', !'Inventario Actual', False, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"ProductoTipoMaterial", '', !'Tipo Material', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"ProductoActivo", '', !'Activo', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"ProductoClaveExterna", '', !'Clave Externa', False, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"ProductoImagen", '', !'Imagen', False, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"ProductNumber", '', !'Producto SAE', True, '')
		
	&UserCustomValue = LoadColumnsSelectorState.Udp(!'Produccion.listarProductosColumnsSelector')
	If not(&UserCustomValue.IsEmpty())
		&ColumnsSelectorAux.FromXml(&UserCustomValue)
		WWP_ColumnSelector_UpdateColumns(&ColumnsSelectorAux, &ColumnsSelector)
	EndIf

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'LoadGridState'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	// Load grid state from session.
	If &Session.Get(!"Produccion.listarProductosGridState") = !""
		&GridState.FromXml(LoadGridState.Udp(!"Produccion.listarProductosGridState"))
	Else
		&GridState.FromXml(&Session.Get(!"Produccion.listarProductosGridState"))
	Endif	

	&OrderedBy = &GridState.OrderedBy
	&OrderedDsc = &GridState.OrderedDsc

	For &GridStateFilterValue in &GridState.FilterValues
		Do Case
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"FILTERFULLTEXT"
				&FilterFullText.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRODUCTOCATEGORIANOMBRE"
				&TFProductoCategoriaNombre.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRODUCTOCATEGORIANOMBRE_SEL"
				&TFProductoCategoriaNombre_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRODUCTOBASEPRODUCTOCLAVE"
				&TFProductoBaseProductoClave.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRODUCTOBASEPRODUCTOCLAVE_SEL"
				&TFProductoBaseProductoClave_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRODUCTOCLAVE"
				&TFProductoClave.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRODUCTOCLAVE_SEL"
				&TFProductoClave_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRODUCTONOMBRE"
				&TFProductoNombre.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRODUCTONOMBRE_SEL"
				&TFProductoNombre_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRODUCTODESCRIPCION"
				&TFProductoDescripcion.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRODUCTODESCRIPCION_SEL"
				&TFProductoDescripcion_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRODUCTOPRECIOUNITARIO"
				&TFProductoPrecioUnitario.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFProductoPrecioUnitario_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRODUCTOINVENTARIOACTUAL"
				&TFProductoInventarioActual.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFProductoInventarioActual_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRODUCTOTIPOMATERIAL_SEL"
				&TFProductoTipoMaterial_SelsJson = &GridStateFilterValue.Value
				&TFProductoTipoMaterial_Sels.FromJson(&TFProductoTipoMaterial_SelsJson)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRODUCTOACTIVO_SEL"
				&TFProductoActivo_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRODUCTOCLAVEEXTERNA"
				&TFProductoClaveExterna.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFProductoClaveExterna_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRODUCTNUMBER"
				&TFProductNumber.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRODUCTNUMBER_SEL"
				&TFProductNumber_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
		EndCase
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'BeforeWriteLine'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */



	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'AfterWriteLine'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */



	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

parm(out:&Filename, out:&ErrorMessage);

=== Procedure: Produccion.listarProductosExportReport ===

--- Source (Source) ---

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

// Exports the contents of a grid (using the selected order and filters) to a PDF file.
&IsAuthorized = SecGAMIsAuthByFunctionalityKey.Udp(!'listarproductos_Execute') 
If &IsAuthorized

	LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)

Do 'LoadGridState'

&Title = "Producto List"

//Report Template Source
	Header
		&AppName = "DVelop Software Solutions"
		&Phone = !"+1 550 8923"
		&Mail = !"info@mail.com"
		&Website = !"http://www.web.com"
		&AddressLine1 = !"French Boulevard 2859"
		&AddressLine2 = !"Downtown"
		&AddressLine3 = !"Paris, France"
		Print printTitle
	End 
	Footer
		&PageInfo = "Page: " + &Page.ToString().Trim()
		&DateInfo = "Date: " + &Today.ToFormattedString()
		Print printFooter
	End

	Do 'PrintFilters'

	Do 'PrintColumnTitles'

	Do 'PrintData'

	Do 'PrintFooter'

EndIf

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


Sub 'PrintFilters'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	If not &FilterFullText.IsEmpty()
		print printBlockFilterFilterFullText
	EndIf
	If not &TFProductoCategoriaNombre_Sel.IsEmpty()
		print printBlockTFProductoCategoriaNombre_Sel
	Else
		If not &TFProductoCategoriaNombre.IsEmpty()
			print printBlockTFProductoCategoriaNombre
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not &TFProductoBaseProductoClave_Sel.IsEmpty()
		print printBlockTFProductoBaseProductoClave_Sel
	Else
		If not &TFProductoBaseProductoClave.IsEmpty()
			print printBlockTFProductoBaseProductoClave
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not &TFProductoClave_Sel.IsEmpty()
		print printBlockTFProductoClave_Sel
	Else
		If not &TFProductoClave.IsEmpty()
			print printBlockTFProductoClave
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not &TFProductoNombre_Sel.IsEmpty()
		print printBlockTFProductoNombre_Sel
	Else
		If not &TFProductoNombre.IsEmpty()
			print printBlockTFProductoNombre
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not &TFProductoDescripcion_Sel.IsEmpty()
		print printBlockTFProductoDescripcion_Sel
	Else
		If not &TFProductoDescripcion.IsEmpty()
			print printBlockTFProductoDescripcion
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not (&TFProductoPrecioUnitario.IsEmpty() AND &TFProductoPrecioUnitario_To.IsEmpty())
		print printBlockTFProductoPrecioUnitario
		&TFProductoPrecioUnitario_To_Description = format('%1 (%2)', "Precio Unitario", "WWP_TSTo")
		print printBlockTFProductoPrecioUnitario_To
	EndIf
	If not (&TFProductoInventarioActual.IsEmpty() AND &TFProductoInventarioActual_To.IsEmpty())
		print printBlockTFProductoInventarioActual
		&TFProductoInventarioActual_To_Description = format('%1 (%2)', "Inventario Actual", "WWP_TSTo")
		print printBlockTFProductoInventarioActual_To
	EndIf
	&TFProductoTipoMaterial_Sels.FromJson(&TFProductoTipoMaterial_SelsJson)
	If not &TFProductoTipoMaterial_Sels.Count = 0
		&i = 1
		For &TFProductoTipoMaterial_Sel in &TFProductoTipoMaterial_Sels
			If &i = 1
				&TFProductoTipoMaterial_SelDscs = ''
			Else
				&TFProductoTipoMaterial_SelDscs += ', '
			EndIf
			&FilterTFProductoTipoMaterial_SelValueDescription = &TFProductoTipoMaterial_Sel.EnumerationDescription()

			&TFProductoTipoMaterial_SelDscs += &FilterTFProductoTipoMaterial_SelValueDescription
			&i += 1
		EndFor
		print printBlockTFProductoTipoMaterial_Sel
	EndIf
	If not &TFProductoActivo_Sel.IsEmpty()
		Do Case
			Case &TFProductoActivo_Sel = 1
				&FilterTFProductoActivo_SelValueDescription = "WWP_TSChecked" 
			Case &TFProductoActivo_Sel = 2
				&FilterTFProductoActivo_SelValueDescription = "WWP_TSUnChecked" 
		EndCase

		print printBlockTFProductoActivo_Sel
	EndIf
	If not (&TFProductoClaveExterna.IsEmpty() AND &TFProductoClaveExterna_To.IsEmpty())
		print printBlockTFProductoClaveExterna
		&TFProductoClaveExterna_To_Description = format('%1 (%2)', "Clave Externa", "WWP_TSTo")
		print printBlockTFProductoClaveExterna_To
	EndIf
	If not &TFProductNumber_Sel.IsEmpty()
		print printBlockTFProductNumber_Sel
	Else
		If not &TFProductNumber.IsEmpty()
			print printBlockTFProductNumber
		EndIf
	EndIf

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'PrintColumnTitles'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	print printBlockBeforeGrid
	print printBlockLines_titles

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'PrintData'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	For each DB.Producto
		order ProductoNombre  when &OrderedBy = 1 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ProductoNombre)  when &OrderedBy = 1 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ProductoCategoriaNombre  when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ProductoCategoriaNombre)  when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ProductoBaseProductoClave  when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ProductoBaseProductoClave)  when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ProductoClave  when &OrderedBy = 4 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ProductoClave)  when &OrderedBy = 4 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ProductoDescripcion  when &OrderedBy = 5 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ProductoDescripcion)  when &OrderedBy = 5 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ProductoPrecioUnitario  when &OrderedBy = 6 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ProductoPrecioUnitario)  when &OrderedBy = 6 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ProductoInventarioActual  when &OrderedBy = 7 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ProductoInventarioActual)  when &OrderedBy = 7 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ProductoTipoMaterial  when &OrderedBy = 8 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ProductoTipoMaterial)  when &OrderedBy = 8 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ProductoActivo  when &OrderedBy = 9 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ProductoActivo)  when &OrderedBy = 9 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ProductoClaveExterna  when &OrderedBy = 10 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ProductoClaveExterna)  when &OrderedBy = 10 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ProductNumber  when &OrderedBy = 11 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ProductNumber)  when &OrderedBy = 11 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		
		using listarProductosDS(&FilterFullText, &TFProductoCategoriaNombre, &TFProductoCategoriaNombre_Sel, &TFProductoBaseProductoClave, &TFProductoBaseProductoClave_Sel, &TFProductoClave
					, &TFProductoClave_Sel, &TFProductoNombre, &TFProductoNombre_Sel, &TFProductoDescripcion, &TFProductoDescripcion_Sel, &TFProductoPrecioUnitario
					, &TFProductoPrecioUnitario_To, &TFProductoInventarioActual, &TFProductoInventarioActual_To, &TFProductoTipoMaterial_Sels, &TFProductoActivo_Sel, &TFProductoClaveExterna
					, &TFProductoClaveExterna_To, &TFProductNumber, &TFProductNumber_Sel)
		&ProductoTipoMaterialDescription = ProductoTipoMaterial.EnumerationDescription()

		Do 'BeforePrintLine'
		print printBlockLines_data
		Do 'AfterPrintLine'
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

				&TFProductoBaseProductoClave_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRODUCTOCLAVE"
				&TFProductoClave.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRODUCTOCLAVE_SEL"
				&TFProductoClave_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)

			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRODUCTONOMBRE_SEL"
				&TFProductoNombre_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRODUCTODESCRIPCION"
				&TFProductoDescripcion.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRODUCTODESCRIPCION_SEL"

			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRODUCTOINVENTARIOACTUAL"
				&TFProductoInventarioActual.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFProductoInventarioActual_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRODUCTOTIPOMATERIAL_SEL"
				&TFProductoTipoMaterial_SelsJson = &GridStateFilterValue.Value
				&TFProductoTipoMaterial_Sels.FromJson(&TFProductoTipoMaterial_SelsJson)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRODUCTOACTIVO_SEL"
				&TFProductoActivo_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRODUCTOCLAVEEXTERNA"

=== Procedure: Produccion.listarProductosGetFilterData ===

--- Source (Source) ---

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

&Options = new()
&OptionsDesc = new()
&OptionIndexes = new()
LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)

Do 'LoadGridState'
Do Case
	Case &DDOName.ToUpper() = !'DDO_PRODUCTOCATEGORIANOMBRE'
		Do 'LoadProductoCategoriaNombreOptions'
	Case &DDOName.ToUpper() = !'DDO_PRODUCTOBASEPRODUCTOCLAVE'
		Do 'LoadProductoBaseProductoClaveOptions'
	Case &DDOName.ToUpper() = !'DDO_PRODUCTOCLAVE'
		Do 'LoadProductoClaveOptions'
	Case &DDOName.ToUpper() = !'DDO_PRODUCTONOMBRE'
		Do 'LoadProductoNombreOptions'
	Case &DDOName.ToUpper() = !'DDO_PRODUCTODESCRIPCION'
		Do 'LoadProductoDescripcionOptions'
	Case &DDOName.ToUpper() = !'DDO_PRODUCTNUMBER'
		Do 'LoadProductNumberOptions'
EndCase

&OptionsJson = &Options.ToJson()
&OptionsDescJson = &OptionsDesc.ToJson()
&OptionIndexesJson = &OptionIndexes.ToJson()

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


Sub 'LoadGridState'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	// Load grid state from session.
	If &Session.Get(!"Produccion.listarProductosGridState") = !""
		&GridState.FromXml(WWPBaseObjects.LoadGridState.Udp(!"Produccion.listarProductosGridState"))
	Else
		&GridState.FromXml(&Session.Get(!"Produccion.listarProductosGridState"))
	Endif	

	For &GridStateFilterValue in &GridState.FilterValues
		Do Case
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"FILTERFULLTEXT"
				&FilterFullText.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRODUCTOCATEGORIANOMBRE"
				&TFProductoCategoriaNombre.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRODUCTOCATEGORIANOMBRE_SEL"
				&TFProductoCategoriaNombre_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRODUCTOBASEPRODUCTOCLAVE"
				&TFProductoBaseProductoClave.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRODUCTOBASEPRODUCTOCLAVE_SEL"
				&TFProductoBaseProductoClave_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRODUCTOCLAVE"
				&TFProductoClave.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRODUCTOCLAVE_SEL"
				&TFProductoClave_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRODUCTONOMBRE"
				&TFProductoNombre.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRODUCTONOMBRE_SEL"
				&TFProductoNombre_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRODUCTODESCRIPCION"
				&TFProductoDescripcion.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRODUCTODESCRIPCION_SEL"
				&TFProductoDescripcion_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRODUCTOPRECIOUNITARIO"
				&TFProductoPrecioUnitario.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFProductoPrecioUnitario_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRODUCTOINVENTARIOACTUAL"
				&TFProductoInventarioActual.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFProductoInventarioActual_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRODUCTOTIPOMATERIAL_SEL"
				&TFProductoTipoMaterial_SelsJson = &GridStateFilterValue.Value
				&TFProductoTipoMaterial_Sels.FromJson(&TFProductoTipoMaterial_SelsJson)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRODUCTOACTIVO_SEL"
				&TFProductoActivo_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRODUCTOCLAVEEXTERNA"
				&TFProductoClaveExterna.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFProductoClaveExterna_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRODUCTNUMBER"
				&TFProductNumber.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRODUCTNUMBER_SEL"
				&TFProductNumber_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
		EndCase
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'LoadProductoCategoriaNombreOptions'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&TFProductoCategoriaNombre = &SearchTxt
	&TFProductoCategoriaNombre_Sel.SetEmpty()
	For Each DB.Producto
		Order ProductoCategoriaId
		using listarProductosDS(&FilterFullText, &TFProductoCategoriaNombre, &TFProductoCategoriaNombre_Sel, &TFProductoBaseProductoClave, &TFProductoBaseProductoClave_Sel, &TFProductoClave
					, &TFProductoClave_Sel, &TFProductoNombre, &TFProductoNombre_Sel, &TFProductoDescripcion, &TFProductoDescripcion_Sel, &TFProductoPrecioUnitario
					, &TFProductoPrecioUnitario_To, &TFProductoInventarioActual, &TFProductoInventarioActual_To, &TFProductoTipoMaterial_Sels, &TFProductoActivo_Sel, &TFProductoClaveExterna
					, &TFProductoClaveExterna_To, &TFProductNumber, &TFProductNumber_Sel)

		&count = 0
		For Each DB.Producto
			Order ProductoCategoriaId
			&count += 1
		EndFor
		If not ProductoCategoriaNombre.IsEmpty()
			&Option = ProductoCategoriaNombre
			
			&InsertIndex = 1
			Do while &InsertIndex <= &Options.Count AND &Options.Item(&InsertIndex) < &Option
				&InsertIndex = &InsertIndex + 1
			EndDo
			&Options.Add(&Option, &InsertIndex)
			&OptionIndexes.Add(trim(&count.ToFormattedString()), &InsertIndex)
		EndIf
		If &Options.Count = 50
			Exit
		EndIf
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'LoadProductoBaseProductoClaveOptions'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&TFProductoBaseProductoClave = &SearchTxt
	&TFProductoBaseProductoClave_Sel.SetEmpty()
	For Each DB.Producto
		Order ProductoBaseProductoClave
		using listarProductosDS(&FilterFullText, &TFProductoCategoriaNombre, &TFProductoCategoriaNombre_Sel, &TFProductoBaseProductoClave, &TFProductoBaseProductoClave_Sel, &TFProductoClave
					, &TFProductoClave_Sel, &TFProductoNombre, &TFProductoNombre_Sel, &TFProductoDescripcion, &TFProductoDescripcion_Sel, &TFProductoPrecioUnitario
					, &TFProductoPrecioUnitario_To, &TFProductoInventarioActual, &TFProductoInventarioActual_To, &TFProductoTipoMaterial_Sels, &TFProductoActivo_Sel, &TFProductoClaveExterna
					, &TFProductoClaveExterna_To, &TFProductNumber, &TFProductNumber_Sel)

		&count = 0
		For Each DB.Producto
			Order ProductoBaseProductoClave
			&count += 1
		EndFor
		If not Produccion.ProductoBaseProductoClave.IsEmpty()
			&Option = ProductoBaseProductoClave
			
			&Options.Add(&Option)
			&OptionIndexes.Add(trim(&count.ToFormattedString()))
		EndIf
		If &Options.Count = 50
			Exit
		EndIf
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'LoadProductoClaveOptions'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&TFProductoClave = &SearchTxt
	&TFProductoClave_Sel.SetEmpty()
	For Each DB.Producto
		Order ProductoClave
		using Produccion.listarProductosDS(&FilterFullText, &TFProductoCategoriaNombre, &TFProductoCategoriaNombre_Sel, &TFProductoBaseProductoClave, &TFProductoBaseProductoClave_Sel, &TFProductoClave
					, &TFProductoClave_Sel, &TFProductoNombre, &TFProductoNombre_Sel, &TFProductoDescripcion, &TFProductoDescripcion_Sel, &TFProductoPrecioUnitario

					, &TFProductoClaveExterna_To, &TFProductNumber, &TFProductNumber_Sel)

		&count = 0
		For Each DB.Producto
			Order ProductoClave
			&count += 1
		EndFor
		If not ProductoClave.IsEmpty()

=== WebPanel: DB.ViewProducto ===

--- Start (Event) ---
If not IsAuthorized(&PgmName)
		NotAuthorized(&PgmName)
	Endif
	For each
		Where ProductoId = &ProductoId
		Form.Caption = ProductoNombre.ToString()
		ViewAll.Link = WWProducto.Link()
		&Exists = True
	When none
		Form.Caption = "Record not found"
		ViewAll.Visible = false
		&Exists = False
	Endfor
	&LoadAllTabs = false
	If &Exists
		&SelectedTabCode = &TabCode
		Tab.ActivePageControlName = &SelectedTabCode
		Do 'Load Tab'
	Endif

--- Tab.TabChanged (Event) ---
&SelectedTabCode = Tab.ActivePageControlName
	&LoadAllTabs = false
	Do 'Load Tab'

--- Rules (Rules) ---
parm(in:&ProductoId, in:&TabCode);


=== WebPanel: DB.WWProducto ===

--- Start (Event) ---
If not IsAuthorized(&PgmName)
		NotAuthorized(&PgmName)
	Endif
	Grid.Rows = 10
	&Update = "GXM_update"
	&Delete = "GX_BtnDelete"
	Form.Caption = 'Productoes'
	Do 'PrepareTransaction'
	Grid.LoadSessionState()

--- Refresh (Event) ---
Grid.SaveSessionState()

--- Grid.Load (Event) ---
&Update.Link = Producto.Link(TrnMode.Update, ProductoId)
	&Delete.Link = Producto.Link(TrnMode.Delete, ProductoId)
	ProductoNombre.Link = ViewProducto.Link(ProductoId, "")
	ProductoCategoriaNombre.Link = ViewProductoCategoria.Link(ProductoCategoriaId, "")

--- 'DoInsert' (Event) ---
Producto(TrnMode.Insert, nullvalue(ProductoId))


=== DataProvider: Produccion.DPCBProducto ===

--- Source (Source) ---

DVB_SDTComboData
Where ProductoCategoriaId = &ProductoCategoriaId when Not &ProductoCategoriaId.IsEmpty()
Where ProductoCategoriaNombre = &ProductoCategoriaNombre when Not &ProductoCategoriaNombre.IsEmpty()
{
	Item
	{
		ID = Notifications.ProductoId.ToString()
		Title = ProductoClave
	}
}

--- Rules (Rules) ---
parm(&ProductoCategoriaId, &ProductoCategoriaNombre);


=== DataProvider: Produccion.ProductoDP ===

--- Source (Source) ---
SDTProducto
Where ProductoId = &ProductoId when Not &ProductoId.IsEmpty()
{
	SDTProductoItem
	{
		ProductoId  = ProductoId 
		ProductoClave  = ProductoClave 
		ProductoNombre  = ProductoNombre 
		ProductoDescripcion  = ProductoDescripcion 
		ProductoCategoriaId  = ProductoCategoriaId 
		ProductoCategoriaNombre  = WWPBaseObjects.ProductoCategoriaNombre 
		ProductoPrecioUnitario  = Notifications.ProductoPrecioUnitario 
		ProductoInventarioActual  = ProductoInventarioActual 
		ProductoActivo  = ProductoActivo 
		ProductoClaveExterna  = ProductoClaveExterna 
		ProductoImagen  = ProductoImagen 
		ProductoTipoMaterial = Produccion.ProductoTipoMaterial
	}
}

--- Rules (Rules) ---
parm(&ProductoId);
